completion.modelUrl.description: Base URL of the model server, e.g. http://localhost:8000.

completion.modelApiKey.description: Bearer token for the model server. Empty = no auth header.

completion.model.description: Model id, e.g. qwen2.5-coder-7b. Empty: server decides which model to use.

completion.temperature.description: Sampling temperature for the inference request. 0.0 = deterministic (greedy); higher = more diverse.

completion.maxTokens.description: Maximum tokens to generate. 32 ≈ 1–3 lines of ghost text; anything larger drifts into codegen.

completion.telemetryUrl.description: Telemetry sink URL, e.g. http://localhost:4000. Empty = telemetry disabled.

completion.telemetryApiKey.description: Bearer token for the telemetry sink. Empty = no auth header.

completion.measureLatency.description: Log per-request latency breakdown to the output channel

completion.fimTemplate.description: FIM template with {prefix} and {suffix} placeholders (dev only use).

completion.sidecarPath.description: Override sidecar binary path (dev only use)
